I used CyteTypeR annotations as a sanity check to see how much it complies with
the authors' own annotation (predicted.pheno).

```{r}
library(CyteTypeR)
library(biomaRt)
library(scuttle)

seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(mat, meta.data = col_meta)

# Ensembl -> gene symbol mapping
mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "btaurus_gene_ensembl")
gene_map <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "external_gene_name"),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = rownames(seurat_obj),
  mart = mart
)
gene_map <- gene_map[gene_map$external_gene_name != "", ]
gene_map <- gene_map[!duplicated(gene_map$ensembl_gene_id), ]

keep <- rownames(seurat_obj) %in% gene_map$ensembl_gene_id
# seurat_obj <- seurat_obj[keep, ]
new_names <- gene_map$external_gene_name[match(rownames(seurat_obj), gene_map$ensembl_gene_id)]
new_names <- uniquifyFeatureNames(rownames(seurat_obj), new_names)
rownames(seurat_obj[["RNA"]]) <- new_names

# Preprocessing
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- ScaleData(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- RunPCA(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- RunUMAP(seurat_obj, dims = 1:30)
seurat_obj <- FindNeighbors(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- FindClusters(seurat_obj, resolution = 0.05)

# Find markers on unbiased clusters
Idents(seurat_obj) <- "seurat_clusters"
markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", only.pos = TRUE, densify = TRUE)

# Step 1: prepare data
prepped_data <- PrepareCyteTypeR(
  obj = seurat_obj,
  marker_table = markers,
  group_key = "seurat_clusters",
  n_top_genes = 50,
  coordinates_key = "umap"
)


# Step 2: submit and annotate
seurat_obj <- CyteTypeR(
  obj = seurat_obj,
  prepped_data = prepped_data,
  study_context = "Cattle cultured meat, muscle tissue, scRNA-seq",
  auth_token = "cyt_p_hQGERf-nExe0GrWN7jIERkFfZ2YRnVGXbdGhfOxUTYk",
  results_prefix = "cytetype_9clusters"
)

seurat_obj@meta.data$cell_type2 <- cytetype_annot$annotation[
    match(as.numeric(as.character(seurat_obj@meta.data$seurat_clusters)) + 1,
          as.numeric(cytetype_annot$clusterId))
  ]
```

Plotting Messmer2023 data as a reproducibility check.

```{r, fig.width = 12}
Inj1 <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = orig.ident %in% c("Injection1"))
Inj2 <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = orig.ident %in% c("Injection2"))
Inj3 <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = orig.ident %in% c("Injection3"))
Inj4 <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = orig.ident %in% c("Injection4"))
Inj5 <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = orig.ident %in% c("Injection5"))
## ----cycle.in-------
cc_orthologs <- getBM(
  attributes = c('ensembl_gene_id', 'hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name'),
  filters = 'with_hsapiens_homolog',
  values = TRUE,
  mart = ensembl
)
cc_orthologs <- cc_orthologs[cc_orthologs$hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name %in%
                               c(cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes, cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes),]

s.genes <- cc_orthologs$ensembl_gene_id[cc_orthologs$hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name %in% cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes]
s.genes <- rownames(Inj1)[rownames(Inj1) %in% s.genes]

g2m.genes <- cc_orthologs$ensembl_gene_id[cc_orthologs$hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name %in% cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes]
g2m.genes <- rownames(Inj1)[rownames(Inj1) %in% g2m.genes]


# normalise in order to perform cell cycle scoring
options(future.globals.maxSize = 10000 * 1024^2)  # 10 GiB
Inj1 <- SCTransform(Inj1, assay = 'RNA', new.assay.name = 'SCT', vars.to.regress = c('percent.mt', 'nFeature_RNA', 'nCount_RNA'))
Inj2 <- SCTransform(Inj2, assay = 'RNA', new.assay.name = 'SCT', vars.to.regress = c('percent.mt', 'nFeature_RNA', 'nCount_RNA'))
Inj3 <- SCTransform(Inj3, assay = 'RNA', new.assay.name = 'SCT', vars.to.regress = c('percent.mt', 'nFeature_RNA', 'nCount_RNA'))
Inj4 <- SCTransform(Inj4, assay = 'RNA', new.assay.name = 'SCT', vars.to.regress = c('percent.mt', 'nFeature_RNA', 'nCount_RNA'))
Inj5 <- SCTransform(Inj5, assay = 'RNA', new.assay.name = 'SCT', vars.to.regress = c('percent.mt', 'nFeature_RNA', 'nCount_RNA'))

# perform cell cycle analysis (make sure to specify the "assay" parameter
Inj1 <- CellCycleScoring(Inj1, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, assay = 'SCT', set.ident = TRUE)
Inj2 <- CellCycleScoring(Inj2, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, assay = 'SCT', set.ident = TRUE)
Inj3 <- CellCycleScoring(Inj3, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, assay = 'SCT', set.ident = TRUE)
Inj4 <- CellCycleScoring(Inj4, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, assay = 'SCT', set.ident = TRUE)
Inj5 <- CellCycleScoring(Inj5, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, assay = 'SCT', set.ident = TRUE)

# normalise again but this time regressing out also the cell cycle scores
Inj1 <- SCTransform(Inj1, assay = 'RNA', new.assay.name = 'SCT', 
                    vars.to.regress = c('percent.mt', 'nFeature_RNA', 'nCount_RNA', 'S.Score', 'G2M.Score'))
Inj2 <- SCTransform(Inj2, assay = 'RNA', new.assay.name = 'SCT', 
                    vars.to.regress = c('percent.mt', 'nFeature_RNA', 'nCount_RNA', 'S.Score', 'G2M.Score'))
Inj3 <- SCTransform(Inj3, assay = 'RNA', new.assay.name = 'SCT',
                    vars.to.regress = c('percent.mt', 'nFeature_RNA', 'nCount_RNA', 'S.Score', 'G2M.Score'))
Inj4 <- SCTransform(Inj4, assay = 'RNA', new.assay.name = 'SCT', 
                    vars.to.regress = c('percent.mt', 'nFeature_RNA', 'nCount_RNA', 'S.Score', 'G2M.Score'))
Inj5 <- SCTransform(Inj5, assay = 'RNA', new.assay.name = 'SCT', 
                    vars.to.regress = c('percent.mt', 'nFeature_RNA', 'nCount_RNA', 'S.Score', 'G2M.Score'))

Inj1 <- RunPCA(Inj1, verbose = FALSE)
Inj2 <- RunPCA(Inj2, verbose = FALSE)
Inj3 <- RunPCA(Inj3, verbose = FALSE)
Inj4 <- RunPCA(Inj4, verbose = FALSE)
Inj5 <- RunPCA(Inj5, verbose = FALSE)


Inj1 <- RunUMAP(Inj1, dims = 1:30)
Inj2 <- RunUMAP(Inj2, dims = 1:30)
Inj3 <- RunUMAP(Inj3, dims = 1:30)
Inj4 <- RunUMAP(Inj4, dims = 1:30)
Inj5 <- RunUMAP(Inj5, dims = 1:30)


# Annotations are now in obj@meta.data
DimPlot(seurat_obj, group.by = "seurat_clusters") #split.by = "orig.ident"
# DimPlot(Inj1, group.by = "predicted.pheno") # shows the effect of Injection time points
FeaturePlot(seurat_obj, features = "MKI67") # this is a proliferation marker
```
